entity_types: Company limited by guarantee under Companies Act 2019 (Act 992) at ORC, then NPO license per Directive for Management of NPOs Operations 2020 and NPOs Policy 2020; Dept. of Social Welfare issues license.
cost_time: ORC statutory fee ~GHS 490 (~$40, 2025) plus non-refundable licensing bank draft to Dept. of Social Welfare; provisional license 3 months, official time unpublished.

entity_types: Association, fondation, ONG under Ordonnance n° 2024-368 du 12 juin 2024 relative à l'organisation de la société civile, superseding Loi 60-315 de 1960; inscription au registre public des OSC.
cost_time: Minimal declaration fee, amount and processing time unpublished. Foreign participation allowed, but foreign-founded NGOs must complete the national declaration and obtain a local base.

entity_types: Association and fondation under Loi n° 2025-19 du 22 juillet 2025 on associations and foundations (replacing the earlier regime); registration in the Registre des Associations et des Fondations.
cost_time: Nominal FCFA registration fee, amount and processing time unpublished. Declaration regime open without prior authorization, but foreign founders need a resident representative.

entity_types: Associations under the French Law of 1 July 1901; foreign ONGs governed by Décret n° 92-130/PMRT (art. 4: compliance before installation); government accord-programme for tax and customs exemptions.
cost_time: No official fee schedule published; declaration at the ministry, time unpublished. Foreign NGOs may operate only after complying with Décret 92-130/PMRT and signing an accord-programme.

entity_types: Association under Loi n° 064-2015/CNT: art. 4 formation without prior authorization, art. 17 public-utility recognition; ONGs need ministry-of-finance approval and an accord-cadre. New 87-article bill adopted July 2025.
cost_time: Registration is nominal (no prior authorization), fee and time unpublished. Foreigners cannot freely found: ONG status requires ministry approval and a signed accord-cadre with the state.

entity_types: Association under Loi n° 04-038/AN-RM du 5 août 2004 (art. 3 modified by ordonnance 2024-008/PT-RM of 28 mars 2024); ONGs under décret n° 05-223/P-RM du 11 mai 2005.
cost_time: Declaration-based registration, fee nominal (few thousand FCFA), time unpublished. Foreign founders need a local base and, for ONG status, an accord-cadre with the government.

entity_types: Association under Loi L/2005/013/AN and ONG under Loi L/2005/014/AN; both declaration-based, filed with the Interior Ministry services; ONG status subject to a government protocol.
cost_time: Nominal registration fee, amount and time unpublished. Foreign founders need a local base; ONG status additionally requires a state accord-cadre (protocol).

entity_types: No single OSC statute; associations/ONGs regulated through dispersed laws with notarial recognition of legal personality (IMVF study §4.3); ONG and religious tax exemptions suspended.
cost_time: Notarial and registry fees nominal, amount and time unpublished. No dedicated channel for foreign founders; NGO activity is handled case by case with the government.

entity_types: Association under Loi n° 71-604 du 20 juillet 1971 (1901-style: declaration at préfecture, récépissé); ONG under décret n° 96-103 du 8 février 1996 as modified by décret n° 2010-1490 du 10 novembre 2010.
cost_time: No official fee for declaration, time unpublished. Foreigners may join associations, but ONG status requires a local base and a signed accord-cadre with the state.

entity_types: Societies registered via the Ministry of Justice Companies Division; NGOs under the NGO Affairs Agency created by NGO Decree No. 81 (1993); company limited by guarantee route; TIN certificate required.
cost_time: MoJ fees: business name 20,000 GMD, company 80,000-90,000 GMD (~$300-350); NGO annual fee ~$5; time unpublished. Non-residents need a resident agent or representative.

entity_types: Company limited by guarantee under Companies Act 2009 (Act No. 5 of 2009) registered at the CAC; charities/NGOs registered as non-profit companies (no separate societies act in force).
cost_time: CAC fee schedule starts around $20 USD, higher bands for companies limited by guarantee; time unpublished. Foreign directors allowed; no registration bar for foreign founders.

entity_types: NGO route: Articles of Incorporation at the Liberia Business Registry, endorsed by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, then submitted to the Ministry of Planning and Economic Affairs (NGO registry).
cost_time: Government incorporation fee ~US$50-550 (provider quotes), annual license ~US$150; official time unpublished. Foreign NGOs operate through the foreign-affairs endorsement path.

entity_types: Association under ordonnance n° 84-06 du 1er mars 1984 and décret n° 84-49/PCMS/MI; ONG sector under décret n° 2022-182/PRN/MAT/DC (agrément protocol regime, financial statements published in the JO).
cost_time: Nominal registration, fee and time unpublished. Since 2022 ONGs need an agrément protocol; ~100 associations were suspended in Feb 2022; foreign founders require a state accord-cadre.

entity_types: No independent civil-society registration regime exists; all social organizations are state or party organs (mass organizations within the state system); independent NGOs are not recognized.
cost_time: n/a - registering a foreign NGO is not possible: every organization is state-sanctioned and foreign activity requires government approval (US persons face OFAC licensing).

entity_types: NCOs under Federal Law 99-FZ 'On Non-Commercial Organizations': public associations, associations/unions, foundations, institutions, autonomous NCOs; registration by the Ministry of Justice.
cost_time: n/a for foreign founders - MoJ registration requires a Russian legal base and state policy; foreign-founded NGOs are effectively barred (foreign-agent law expanded 1 Dec 2022).
